notes.title: Quick 0.06.11 patch
notes.content:
0.06.11
		

Fixed:
Researching an item now works if you have the exact amount needed to research it... I had a > instead of >=... oops

notes.title: Playtest Update v 0.06.10
notes.content:
So I lost track of everything I changed... or just didn't take notes... but the general idea is that I did a lot of little things and some less little things too. But I did at the very least this:



Added:
 Gulls
 There is now an animation for when you research an item


Fixed:
You can no longer transfer stacks into containers that you are not allowed to put things in, ie: Lost&Found
Local Goods Shop in Town Hall was borked, tisn't any more.


Changed:
There is now an animation when researching items.

notes.title: Playtest 0.06.08 - Slick's new occupation
notes.content:
0.06.08:
		

Added:

Slick, the wolf in Thimbleton, now has a secondary activity of creating sculptures that you give items to for them to be completed.

Fixed:
Crafted Wooden Posts actually appear when placed in the world.
Time would sometimes un-pause while navigating in the pause menu.
		
Changed:
Notification displayed when an item is sent to the Lost and Found
Shadows at night are now different.

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.06.07
notes.content:
Added:
Max Framerate settings in Options.
Scarekernut, used to scare off Cokernut Flump.
 Inventory slots have tooltips for items with variants and items that can be researched.


Fixed:
When getting a Warning panel you can no longer interact with menu buttons on other panels.
Containers that you cannot put things in no longer show the " ^ (place all)" button.	
Inputting an invalid character into the name field is also red when the input field is not selected. 
Controller prompts in the tabbed menu only show when actually using a controller.
Inconsistencies with the running/jumping gauge when landing after a jump from a high level.
Some recipes had no crafting station.
Some recipes were impossible to learn.
Using shift in menus and UI screens no longer toggles running.


Changed:
Farm plant time-cycles changed to a shorter period of time.

notes.title: Update 0.06.06
notes.content:
There are many more changes and updates and fixes than what's written here. But know that you need to start a fresh playthrough, as usual I guess. 


Changed:
 Sounds from crafting stations are now more or less appropriate
 Selected recipes in crafting stations update according to your inventory when you take something from its container.

 Fixed:		
 NPC's will always stop walking when you talk to them.

Added:		
 Villagers you encounter are now added to your compendiums.
 Cokernut Flump, out there breakin' yer stuff.

notes.title: Update 0.06.05
notes.content:
Again, sorry, but you need to start fresh, old saves will be broken and irrelevant.

All the things!!!



Added:	

 In the Options>Gameplay menu you can now enable the "console", a way to add items, change the time, teleport, etc... I think it might be useful for playtesters, but optional. The console being active will not save as an option, you will have to enable it each game-launch if you want it. 
 Backpacks!! a way to expand your inventory
 Beets
 The Squonk
 Spade Minigame
 Dynamibubbles
 Junk piles


Fixed:

 Research items only show once in the research station buttons when you have more than one stack of said item.


Changed:	

 Research stations now show what item is selected to be researched.
 Undertaking with more than one similar task will now show as one task with a completed and total indication (eg: Do a thing 1/5)

Fixed:		
 Exiting the menu with ESC when the choose amount window is visible now also closes said choose amount window.
 You should be able to use TAB or ESC to close almost any UI screen.
 Purple rain now shows requirements when holding F.

Changed:
 Getting a new piece of map now automatically opens up the map UI to show the revealing of said map.
 You can now add a stack of fuel to a crafting station instead of one by one.
 Changed how much wood/ore you get from harvesting with different tier tools.
 Harvesting now checks only the nearest items that are harvestable with that tool.

notes.title: patch 0.06.03
notes.content:
Hello!
I re-fixed a bug... I thought I had fixed the daily spawning of items to no longer have doubles and triples, but I was very very wrong, and that bug made me find another bug in the save system.... 
It should be all fixed now :) ask me about it in the stream, if you're interested.

Hello! first playtest version is up and running!!

Fixed:
Slopes are a fair amount better than they were (approaching from the side and falling off the side...)
